announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholdings
announcements.insight: Standard regulatory disclosure of individual director shareholdings lacks the materiality to influence valuation; without context on transaction direction (buy/sell) or volume relative to total float, this is purely administrative data with no immediate strategic implication for Capital for Colleagues plc.
